# Triple-store research and source index

4 November 2026. Start with [the ten-goal Mac handoff](mac-complete-ten-goals-20261104.md), then follow the topic needed. This is a curated index of already published project research plus a new consolidated Goal10 source audit. It is not a backup, an indiscriminate thread export or a claim that every local file is published.

## Coverage and provenance

The source map covers the original typed core and expression work, the independent native-v0.6 and direct continuations, independent3.1, independent4.1, aggregate conformance, invocation control, complete-history/recovery work, safe cache/CQ work, interval-history research and Triplex integration. The handoff pins all ten PR branches/heads and their actual test boundaries.

Main research was inventoried through the selected project research tree, not by scanning the computer. Branch-only filenames were verified against each PR's full changed-file listing. Links below pin the observed main or exact PR head. Presence is evidence of remote preservation, not correctness or runtime acceptance. Follow each document's scope and original source citations.

**Do not use a link or an old plan to revive a stopped action.** Original goal3/4 work, canceled saves/backups, frozen acquisition/migration/runner/database operations and unresolved calls remain held as documented. This index does not copy their payloads. Existing historical research can explain a constraint without authorizing execution. No computer inventory, environment snapshot, raw private notes, secret or canceled backup is included.

Known incomplete preservation: goal8's later local terminal/result-review packet is summarized by the latest audit, but not remotely verified; goal9's later continuation/publication is unverified. The handoff does not pretend those gaps are closed.

## Source-of-truth and recovery rules

Keep the latest source hash, actual command, initial terminal outcome and complete selected test result together. A published result does not update its implementation's acceptance automatically. A source parse/build, synthetic model, retained-receipt review and actual real-engine run are different kinds of evidence.

Current unknown operations must be reconciled through their owner rather than inferred from a quiet branch or an activity label. Do not inspect hidden session logs, inventory processes/computers, reconstruct forbidden snapshots or repeat uncertain publication to close a documentation gap. Ask the parent for missing supported evidence.

No test was run by preparing this index. No implementation branch, PR description, held artifact or dependency was changed.
